posts.title: Sometimes i'm dreaming
posts.body:
``` By bedtime all the faces, the voices had blurred for Charlotte to one face, one voice. She prepared herself for bed, very slowly and deliberately, cleaning her teeth with the new green toothbrush, undressing awkwardly because she did not like to hide herself in the washing-cubicle with her fellow new girl, Susannah; but she was on the other hand much too shy and strange to undress as openly as the other three, Vanessa, Janet and Elizabeth. Vanessa wandered about for ten minutes at least in just her vest and navy-blue school knickers. She had freckles all over her legs. Charlotte had never seen anyone with freckled legs before. ```

``` All the faces All the voices blur Change to one face Change to one voice Prepare yourself for bed The light seems bright And glares on white walls All the sounds of Charlotte sometimes Into the night with Charlotte sometimes ```

posts.title: the man without the head
option value pricing model
posts.body:
I kept hearing the phrase _option value pricing model_ in my head, hearing it over and over 

_option value pricing model_
_option value pricing model_

but I had only the vaguest notion anymore of what this meant 

it was like waking up after a dream in which you've been speaking a foreign language only to find out you that you don't speak the language at all 

and barely even understand a word of it

["No Time" by mark fisher](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Bk0kkRPmjE)
